reference: EnergyPlus 24.x via OpenStudio-HPXML v1.9.1 on NRCan Quebec all-electric archetypes
method: Full heating curtailment 16:00-19:00 replayed identically on both models over the coldest week. RC takes it as p_cap_kw=0; EnergyPlus as a setpoint floored below indoor temperature, because hvac_maximum_power_ratio is honoured only for variable-speed heat pumps. Measured on a 15-dwelling holdout disjoint from the 14 used to fit. COVERS shifted energy, rebound and thermal inertia. DOES NOT cover instantaneous coincidence: EnergyPlus steps >2 kW in 22.1% of 15-min intervals against 45.1% measured, so the Hydro-Quebec set is the arbiter for that axis, not this reference. Partial power caps are out of scope.
